last_episode_to_air.name: Spring 1866 - Summer 1866
last_episode_to_air.overview: When George Hazard learns that it's his sister-in-law who owns the majority shares in the mining operation at Mont Royal, he turns to his brother Stanley, who again does the right thing. George returns to Mont Royal with Madeline and as the new owner of the mine, makes his first act shuttering the company store. He and Madeline soon fall in love. When George learns that Bent has kidnapped Charlie's young son, he sets off to find him. He and Charlie track Bent down for a final confrontation. Back in South Carolina, George and Madeline prepare for an attack from the Klan. Ashton returns to find what remains of her beloved Mont Royal.

name: North and South
overview: The story of the enduring friendship between Orry Main of South Carolina and George Hazard of Pennsylvania, who become best friends while attending the United States Military Academy at West Point but later find themselves and their families on opposite sides of the American Civil War.

seasons.name: Book I
seasons.overview: Two friends, one northern and one southern, struggle to maintain their friendship as events build towards the American Civil War.

seasons.name: Book II
seasons.overview: The story of two friends and their families on opposite sides of the American Civil War.

seasons.name: Book III
seasons.overview: The Civil War has just ended, but things in the country aren't much better, especially in the south.
